desktop.notes: Smooth 4K playback with fast bilinear hardware downscaling and buffer jitter margin, clicking video picture toggles playback controls and stream details, and expanded international sports guide feed matching.

android.notes: Real-time stream health tracking on OK button press, automatic VOD background prefetch and fallback cache loading, and multi-country alias matching for sports feeds (e.g. Portugal, Greece, Sub-Saharan Africa).
